source_title: Celebrity Friends Who Fell Out Publicly — and Where They Stand Today - People.com
source_excerpt:
From Selena Gomez and Francia Raisa to Kylie Jenner and Jordyn Woods, look back at the famous BFFs who had long-lasting feuds
Peter Kramer/Getty; Emma McIntyre/Getty; Frazer Harrison/Getty
Some of the most famous celebrity duos have had their friendships tested at times.
And while some public friendship fallouts like The Simple Life costars Paris Hilton and Nicole Richie’s rift in their 20s and Kylie Jenner and Jordyn Woods ’ very public friendship breakup came to eventual reconciliations, other celebrity pals have remained fractured.
“I mean, we’ve all known each other for, now longer than we were alive when we didn’t, and they’re some of the longest relationships of my life ,” actress Sophia Bush told PEOPLE of her relationships with One Tree Hill costars Hilarie Burton Morgan and Bethany Joy Lenz in October 2026. “One thing I really value is that no matter what anyone’s going through, we wait for each other.”
She added, “I think that’s really important when you have friction or ease, that no matter what, you’re there, whether it’s easy or hard. That’s something I really do appreciate about all of us.”
Lenz had previously said she and Burton Morgan were not speaking as of 2024, but kept the door for reconciliation open at the time.
Below, learn more about celebrity friends who had a public fallout — and where they stand now.
Roy Rochlin/WireImage; Michael Loccisano/Getty
The Friendship: Stewart and Ina Garten became friends back in the ‘90s, when they both lived in the Hamptons on New York’s Long Island. Garten would later write a column for Martha Stewart Living and secured her first book deal with Stewart’s help after bringing a publisher to her specialty food store The Barefoot Contessa .
The Fallout: In her September 2024 profile in The New Yorker , Garten claimed that the pair lost touch when Stewart began spending more time at her Bedford, N.Y., home. Then, when Stewart visited Watch What Happens Live in October 2024, host Andy Cohen brought up Garten’s recently released memoir Be Ready When the Luck Happens , in which she also claimed the friendship slowed when Stewart moved away.
Stewart responded, “ That’s not true .” She then alleged that the pair stopped talking “after I went to jail.”
The lifestyle guru had previously told The New Yorker the same thing, with the author noting in the profile that Garten denied the accusation.
“When I was sent off to Alderson Prison, she stopped talking to me. I found that extremely distressing and extremely unfriendly,” Stewart said.
The Status: Stewart told PEOPLE at the time that she doesn’t see herself rekindling her friendship with Garten again, even though she’s put their beef behind her: “ No, she’s into her own thing . That’s okay.”
During a live Q&A with PEOPLE in December of that year, the Food Network host said Stewart’s “story isn’t exactly accurate.”
“And, you know, that was 25 years ago,” Garten added. “I think it’s time to let it go.”
The Friendship: James Franco and Seth Rogen became friends in 1999 after working together on Freaks and Geeks . Years later, they would join forces on several films, including Knocked Up (2007), Pineapple Express (2008) , This Is the End (2013), The Interview (2014), Sausage Party (2016) and The Disaster Artist (2017).
The Fallout: In January 2018, five women — four of whom were his acting students — accused Franco of sexually inappropriate behavior in a Los Angeles Times article . Two of the four former students would go on to file a sexual misconduct lawsuit against the actor in October 2019, which he settled in February 2021 .
Once the allegations against Franco came to light, Rogen distanced himself from his longtime collaborator , telling The Sunday Times in May 2021 that he had no plans to work with Franco in the future.
“What I can say is that I despise abuse and harassment , and I would never cover or conceal the actions of someone doing it, or knowingly put someone in a situation where they were around someone like that,” Rogen said.
The Status: Franco told Variety in October 2024 that his friendship with Rogen was likely beyond repair .
“I haven’t talked to Seth. I love Seth, we had 20 great years together, but I guess it’s over ,” he said.
Rogen later confirmed Franco’s suspicions in June 2026, when he told The New York Times that he hadn’t spoken to his former collaborator “in a long time.”
“I honestly think the nuance of it is too personal for me to get into right now,” The Studio star said. “It is a very personal thing. There’s the public-facing side of it, which I’ve spoken about, and I have the same stance publicly that I’ve had, and I think the proof is in the pudding — I have not worked with him in years. “
Rogen added, “Nothing has changed since the last time I talked about all this. I haven’t worked with him in a really long time, and I have no plans to.”
Hilarie Burton Morgan and Bethany Joy Lenz
The Friendship: Hilarie Burton Morgan and Bethany Joy Lenz became fast friends on the set of One Tree Hill , which aired from 2003 to 2012. Nearly a decade later, in 2021, they launched a rewatch podcast , Drama Queens , with former costar Sophia Bush . Both Burton Morgan and Lenz also appeared on an episode of the Bush-led CBS series Good Sam in 2022.
The Fallout: Starting in early 2024, fans began speculating that something may be amiss between the two when they appeared less and less on each other’s social media. Then, in October 2024, Lenz confirmed on Alex Cooper ‘s Call Her Daddy podcast that she and Burton Morgan weren’t speaking.
“I love Hilarie, I have always and will always, and I don’t have any problem with her,” Lenz said. “ There have been some bizarre misunderstandings .”
Some fans suspected their issues may have stemmed from the similar-looking book covers of their memoirs, Burton Morgan’s The Rural Diaries (2020) and Lenz’s Dinner for Vampires (2024), while others believed it potentially had to do with clashing political opinions, according to Glamour .
In July 2024, Burton Morgan announced she was stepping back from Drama Queens , sharing on the podcast that “ we have reached the end of my behind-the-scenes experience on the show, and so I really started to question what I brought to this, but also how we keep that storytelling alive and important.”
The Status: Lenz left the door open for reconciliation, saying, “I really hope we can figure out [the misunderstandings] one day, but I love that girl.”
The Friendship: Ted Danson and Kelsey Grammer starred as Sam Malone and Frasier Crane on Cheers . Their on-screen rivalry for Diane Chambers ‘ ( Shelley Long ) heart reflected their strained relationship off-screen.
The Fallout: During an October 2024 episode of Danson’s podcast Where Everybody Knows Your Name , which he co-hosts with former Cheers costar Woody Harrelson , Danson recalled a moment in which he felt frustrated with Grammer.
“This isn’t self-deprecating, but I wish — I feel like I got stuck a little bit with you during the Cheers years. I have a memory of getting angry at you once,” Danson said to Grammer, who was a guest on the podcast.
Grammer responded, “Yeah, you came and told me that one day.”
“And it’s stuck in both of our memories,” Danson continued. “But I feel like, f---, I don’t know. I missed out on the last 30 years of Kelsey Grammer, and I feel like it’s my bad , my doing, and I almost feel like apologizing to you.”
The Status: Once Danson apologized, the two actors declared their rift was water under the bridge.
“My love for you has always been as easy as the day. You know, as easy as the sunrise,” Grammer later said.
The Friendship: Hilton and Richie had been friends long before they were on every magazine cover for their early-aughts antics, and they cemented their place in pop culture history by starring together on the reality show The Simple Life from 2003 to 2007.
The Fallout: Rumors of a rift between the longtime BFFs began circulating in 2005. Hilton added gasoline to the fire when she said she wanted a new costar for The Simple Life and named Rod Stewart ‘s daughter Kimberly Stewart as a potential replacement.
In April 2005, Hilton confirmed that there was indeed a feud between her and Richie.
“It’s no big secret that Nicole and I are no longer friends,” she said in a statement. “ Nicole knows what she did , and that’s all I’m ever going to say about it.”
At the time, a source close to Hilton told PEOPLE that Richie was jealous of the media attention Hilton was receiving and being left out of her costar’s Saturday Night Live hosting gig two months prior. However, a source close to Richie said the two had gone their separate ways, as Richie was becoming more mature and wanted to spend time with her then-fiancé DJ Adam Goldstein . (Goldstein was found dead in his N.Y.C. apartment in August 2009, nearly one year after surviving a plane crash .)
The Status: Hilton and Richie didn’t stay apart long. By 2006, the friends were back on good terms .
In May 2024, the former reality stars announced they would be returning to the small screen for what they called “a new era” of The Simple Life . Ahead of the launch of the three-part series Paris & Nicole: The Encore on Peacock in December 2024, Hilton told E! News in June, “I’m so excited to be doing this with Nicole on Peacock. Nicole has been my best friend since we’re 2 years old; every memory that I have is with her.”
The Friendship: Selena Gomez and Francia Raisa became friends after meeting at a charity event in 2007. The two were so tight, in fact, that when the Wizards of Waverly Place alum needed a kidney transplant following her lupus diagnosis , Raisa stepped up to the plate and donated the organ to her friend in September 2017.
The Fallout: In November 2022, Gomez told Rolling Stone that her “only friend” in the entertainment industry was Taylor Swift . Gomez also didn’t mention Raisa in her Apple TV documentary, My Mind & Me , which featured some of her friends. For nearly a year after that, she and Raisa avoided directly speaking about a rumored rift.
The Status: The two seemed to have mended fences when Gomez shared a post on Instagram in July 2023, celebrating Raisa’s birthday.
A few months later, Raisa attended Gomez’s benefit for the Rare Impact Fund in October.
“Well, she has a piece of my body, so [it’s] super important,” the Grown-ish star told PEOPLE of her friendship with Gomez. “But honestly, aside from that — regardless of that, I think we just missed each other .”
Raisa continued, “Even though we’ve had our zigzags in life, we could still come together and be friends and still have our old times. I’m just so glad that we’re back together.”
The Friendship: Lindsay Lohan and Hilton were besties in the mid-2000s, often photographed alongside other starlets of the time, including Britney Spears , while out partying together.
The Fallout: Things between Lohan and Hilton seemed to take a turn in 2006 when The Parent Trap star was rumored to have been involved with Hilton’s ex Stavros Niarchos . A few days later, Hilton was seen laughing while pretending to take a call as her friend Brandon Davis said unsavory things about Lohan to the paparazzi, E! News reported , also noting that the two always acted more like “frienemies.”
In the years that followed, the two would continue to throw shade .
Hilton publicly called Lohan “lame” and “embarrassing” in May 2019, with the Mean Girls star responding by complimenting the hotel heiress on her new song, writing in a since-deleted post on Instagram, “#beyond friends are true. Love @parishilton congratulations on your new song!”
The Status: During an appearance on Watch What Happens Live in January 2022, Hilton revealed the two had moved on from their past beef.
“I just feel like we’re grown-ups now. I just got married. She just got engaged. We’re not in high school,” she told Cohen. “I think it was just very immature and now everything is all good.”
The following year, Hilton even congratulated Lohan on her pregnancy news. (Lohan and husband Badar Shammas welcomed son Luai in July 2023.)
“ I’m so excited for her ,” the 11:11 Media founder and CEO said. “It’s just exciting to see all of my friends growing up and starting families on their own.”
In January 2026, Hilton returned to WWHL , telling Cohen that she and Lohan are planning playdates with their kids. (Hilton shares two kids with husband Carter Reum , whom she married in L.A. in November 2021.)
The Friendship: Woods and Jenner were practically inseparable in the early 2010s. Not only would Woods constantly feature on Kylie’s Snapchat, but she even made a few appearances on Keeping Up with the Kardashians .
The Fallout: Woods and Jenner’s friendship went down the drain when Tristan Thompson , who was dating Jenner’s sister Khloé Kardashian , kissed Woods at a party in 2019. The debacle played out on the internet and the famous family ‘s reality TV show.
The Status: The two reunited and were photographed leaving a restaurant in L.A. in July 2023. While Jenner told Interview in November of that year that she and Woods “never fully cut each other off” and would talk over the years, it wasn’t until they made a TikTok video together in September 2024 that the public saw them hanging out like old times again.
The BFFs were spotted courtside at an NBA game in May 2025, and the makeup mogul later congratulated Woods on her engagement to basketball star Karl-Anthony Towns in December 2025.
Jenner was also one of the guests at Woods and Towns’ Malibu wedding in August 2026.
The Friendship: Drake Bell and Josh Peck starred on their eponymous Nickelodeon show Drake & Josh together from 2004 to 2007.
The Fallout: Though their characters on the show were tight, the pair weren’t as close in real life and lost contact once they stopped filming.
According to his former costar, Bell got upset when he wasn’t invited to Peck’s 2017 wedding to Paige O’Brien .
“ I get married to my wife , and I marry this good Irish Catholic girl. ... We have this small wedding. The dirty little secret, I guess, was like, I knew that Drake and I didn’t stay in touch for the 10 years since we had made the show. But no one needed to know that,” Josh explained while on the BFFs with Dave Portnoy and Josh Richards podcast in March 2022.
“Like, I was happy to just die with that secret that we made this thing that people really love, but maybe we weren’t that close. So I didn’t invite him to my wedding because I hadn’t really talked to him in many, many years.”
The Status: The two have since patched things up, as Bell revealed Josh was there for him after he revealed he had been sexually abused by Nickelodeon dialogue coach Brian Peck (to whom Josh has no relation).
“ He reached out to me privately and, you know, didn’t go straight to the media because, you know, he was there with me and, and saw what I was going through,” Bell said while on the Not Skinny But Not Fat podcast in April 2024, noting that Josh didn’t know the “specifics” of his abuse but had suspected something wasn’t right.
“I think that when he just knew how sensitive this was for me, and after, of course, watching the documentary, he learned of so much that I had gone through,” the “I Know” singer continued. “I think that he was just so sensitive and made sure to reach out to me privately rather than just going straight to social media or something.”
The Friendship: Kim Cattrall and Parker played best friends Samantha Jones and Carrie Bradshaw on Sex and the City for six seasons of the show, plus two additional movies .
The Fallout: Things between Cattrall and her SATC costar became publicly tense when rumors came out that she had been the reason a third Sex and the City movie stalled . Cattrall denied the claims, saying she never agreed to do the film to begin with.
In a 2017 interview on ITV’ s Piers Morgan ‘s Life Stories , Cattrall told Morgan that she had “never been friends” with her costars, explaining, “We’ve been colleagues, and in some way, it’s a very healthy place to be.”
The rumored tension increased when Cattrall lost her brother in February 2018, and Parker sent her well-wishes.
“I don’t need your love or support at this tragic time,” Cattrall wrote on Instagram , adding, “Your continuous reaching out is a painful reminder of how cruel you really were then and now.”
For her part, Parker denied having any ill will towards her former costar.
“I never responded to the conversation that Kim had with Piers Morgan, where she said things that were really hurtful about me,” Parker told PEOPLE at the time. “I don’t want to answer it; that’s not how I feel about her . I think of her as part of this [ Sex and the City ] experience, and it was amazing. We had a connection with the audience, and we had a connection with this city and with this crew and we got to tell these crazy stories with each other. And I don’t want to mess with that.”
The Status: The hatchet remains unburied, but Cattrall appeased Sex and the City fans who were missing her presence on the spinoff And Just Like That... by making a small cameo on the season 2 finale .
Before that cameo, in June 2022, Parker shared that “it’s very hard to talk about the situation.”
“I’ve been so careful about not ever wanting to say anything that is unpleasant, because it’s not the way I like to conduct conversations that are as complicated as this, you know? It’s so painful for people to keep talking about this ‘catfight’ — a fight, a fight, a fight,” she said during an appearance on The Hollywood Reporter ‘s Awards Chatter podcast. “I’ve never uttered fighting words in my life about anybody that I’ve worked with ever. There is not a ‘fight’ going on. There has been no public dispute or spat or conversations or allegations made by me or anybody on my behalf.”
Parker added, “So I just wish that they would stop calling this a ‘catfight’ or an ‘argument,’ because it doesn’t reflect, actually — there has been one person talking. And I’m not going to tell her not to, or anybody, so that’s been kind of painful for me also.”
The Friendship: Outside of Hilton and Richie, there was perhaps no more famous pair of BFFs in the 2000s than reality TV stars Heidi Montag and Lauren Conrad . The pair’s friendship was, in essence, the center of MTV’s The Hills .
The Fallout: Things took a turn for these two when Montag began dating Spencer Pratt , whom Conrad didn’t approve of. According to Montag, Conrad even threatened to get her booted off the show if she didn’t break up with Pratt.
“She had a boyfriend I didn’t like when she was with Jason [Wahler] , and I supported her,” Montag said on Call Her Daddy in August 2021. “I literally was like, ‘I’m your girl, I’m here for you, whoever you’re with I just want to support you with .’ “
Montag continued, “And then when that whole Spencer thing happened, she’s like, ‘Well, if you date Spencer, you’re off the show,’ and I’m like, ‘What? You are not the friend that I am to you, like why would you do that to me? I can’t even believe you’re doing this to me right now.’ “
For her part, Conrad claimed that Montag had spread a rumor that she and Wahler had a sex tape, which Montag always denied. Pratt would later admit to having spread the lie .
“Lauren is a cold-hearted killer,” Pratt told Complex in October 2015. “That’s what people don’t get. She will cut you in your sleep. She tried to destroy us. If you want to throw missiles, I’m throwing a nuke. This is how I operate.”
The Status: Though Montag said she has “such a love for Lauren,” their friendship never got back on track.
The Friendship: For 10 years, Anderson Cooper and Kathy Griffin hosted CNN’s New Year’s Eve broadcast . The two were a dynamic duo , with Griffin’s no-holds-barred humor cutting through Anderson’s perfectly poised persona.
The Fallout: In May 2017, Griffin posed with a replica of President Donald Trump ‘s bloodied, decapitated head in her hand. The backlash against the photo was swift, and Cooper was among those who spoke out against Griffin’s actions .
“For the record, I am appalled by the photo shoot Kathy Griffin took part in,” he wrote on X at the time. “It is clearly disgusting and completely inappropriate.”
The Status: It seems their friendship never recovered.
Griffin told Variety in March 2019, “ It still hurts . I mean, I really loved him. I don’t have a punchline for that one.”
Will Friedle, Danielle Fishel, Rider Strong and Ben Savage
ABC Photo Archives/Disney General Entertainment Content via Getty
The Friendship: Boy Meets World was led by Savage, who portrayed Cory Matthews, from 1993 to 2000. Alongside him was Fishel as Cory’s girlfriend (and eventually wife ) Topanga Lawrence , Strong as BFF Shawn Hunter and Friedle as Cory’s big brother Eric Matthews. Bonded by growing up together on-screen, the castmates stayed close friends and even reprised their roles for Disney Channel’s reboot Girl Meets World .
The Fallout: Girl Meets World wrapped in 2017. Fishel, Strong and Friedle would go on to create the rewatch podcast Pod Meets World . They asked Savage to be a part of the project, but he not only rejected the idea, he allegedly stopped answering calls and texts from his former costars. The trio spoke about the complex situation, which began around 2020, in the documentary Doc Meets World .
The Status: Fishel, Strong and Friedle still cohost the podcast together. They remain cut off from Savage but retain hope that the friendship can be rekindled one day.
“There’s so many times I want to pick up the phone and still do. I know I’m shouting into the void, but I’m going to keep doing it,” Friedle told PEOPLE in 2026. “I haven’t given up on my friend. And I’m hoping that he comes back into our lives at some point, and when he does, we’re going to have a lot to talk about.”
For her part, Fishel explained that Savage was very involved in her life and her children’s lives (she has two sons, Adler and Keaton ) before their friendship came to a sudden halt. Since then, Savage married Tessa Angermeier , and they welcomed their first baby together , a girl, in November 2025.
Fishel told PEOPLE that she imagines what his life is like now and is “sad” that she can’t find out how he’s doing, but also said she comes “from a place of immense understanding and grace when it comes to the fact that not everybody wants to look back over their past with a fine-tooth comb.”
“Not everybody wants to talk about uncomfortable truths. Honestly, there’s nothing wrong with not wanting to do that,” she explained. “The three of us said it was something that we did want to do. And although we were nervous, it was a journey we were willing and excited to go down.”
